caption: The video showcases an elaborate domino installation arranged on a wooden floor against a pale wall trimmed with a wood baseboard. Tall vertical columns of multicolored dominoes stand at the left, while a horizontal board displays a red, green, and blue zigzag pattern toward the center-right. A winding clear-plastic rail track snakes across the scene carrying several triangular clusters, and long rainbow-striped rows on the floor-left point toward it, each ending at a small tan wooden launcher. Two already-fallen piles of red and white dominoes rest along the bottom edge. Throughout the clip the camera slowly reframes the setup, sliding so the left columns drift partly off the frame edge while a white domino structure at the right edge enters view. The standing arrangements remain intact, though a dark object moves steadily along the upper track from the right toward the center. As the view shifts, the fallen pile at the bottom is progressively cut off by the lower frame edge.
relations: As the camera slides left, the tall left columns drift partly off-frame while a white domino structure enters at the right edge.
A dark object travels steadily along the upper winding track from right toward center, leaving standing arrangements intact.
The bottom red-and-white fallen pile is progressively cropped by the lower frame edge as the view shifts.
Rainbow floor rows and their tan launchers remain upright and unchanged during the reframing motion.
